title: DispatchImpactPrimitive
description: Dispatches macro, contextual, and commodity-level metric impulses to ImpactRouter and UniversalMetricSink.

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline step.

load_from_folder.description: Path to directory containing authored impact profile JSON files (e.g. res://data_modules/core/verbs/buy/impacts/).

direct_deltas.description: Dictionary mapping metric keys to explicit numeric delta impulses.

target_node_id.description: Target district or entity ID to receive the impact impulses (defaults to action context target).

commodity_activations.description: When true, evaluates and applies commodity-specific activations from traded catalog items.

error_code.description: Failure code if impact loading or dispatching fails.

next_step.description: ID of next step on completion, or null to terminate pipeline.
